blurb: ASI Dance Elite offers dance classes in various styles including ballet, jazz, tap, hip-hop, lyrical, contemporary, and musical theatre. Classes are available for all ages and levels, with options for private lessons. The studio also hosts events like winter productions and offers gift cards and free trial classes.
